text: At its meeting on June 9, 2025, the Confronting Anti-Black Racism Advisory Committee considered item CR6.2 and made recommendations to Economic and Community Development Committee.

The Economic and Community Development Committee: 1. Requested the Confronting Anti-Black Racism Unit, Social Development, to invite the Toronto Police Service to present to the Confronting Anti-Black Racism Advisory Committee on the status and timeline of implementation of the Ontario Human Rights Commission recommendations following the next scheduled update to the Toronto Police Service Board on this matter.
